criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Unauthorized Transactions & Fraud
categories.definition: Queries about unrecognized charges, suspicious activity, or needing to freeze a card due to fraudulent use.

categories.name: Card Functionality Issues
categories.definition: Problems with a card not working, being declined, contactless issues, or general card malfunctions.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Problems with sending or receiving money, including failed, blocked, pending, missing transfers, incorrect amounts, or transfer cancellation/correction.

categories.name: Account Information Update
categories.definition: Requests to change personal details, contact information, or other account-related settings.

categories.name: Card Ordering & Delivery
categories.definition: Inquiries about ordering new physical, virtual, or disposable cards, checking delivery status, or questions about card types.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about the identity verification process, required documents, or issues encountered during verification.

categories.name: Fees & Charges Inquiry
categories.definition: Questions about specific fees, unexpected charges, or general pricing for any banking service.

categories.name: Top-up Issues & Inquiries
categories.definition: Questions about adding money to an account, top-up methods, limits, verification, or problems with top-ups.

categories.name: Refunds
categories.definition: Inquiries about missing refunds or requests for refunds on purchases or products.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Explicit requests to close, delete, or terminate an account.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: Issues or inquiries related to a card's PIN, such as changing, resetting, unblocking, or delivery.

categories.name: Transaction Status & History
categories.definition: Questions about the status of a known transaction (pending, completed), understanding statement entries, or general inquiries about transaction details.

categories.name: Lost or Stolen Card/Phone
categories.definition: Reporting a lost or stolen physical card or phone, and related actions like card reactivation after being found.

categories.name: ATM & Card Usage Locations
categories.definition: Inquiries about where a card can be used, ATM locations, or specific ATM functionalities (e.g., card retained by ATM, incorrect cash dispensed).

categories.name: Exchange Rates & Currency
categories.definition: Questions about currency exchange rates, fees related to exchange, or supported currencies.

categories.name: Account Eligibility & General Information
categories.definition: Questions about who can open an account, age limits, adding family members, or general service availability.

categories.name: App & Login Issues
categories.definition: Problems accessing the account through the app or website, or password resets.

categories.name: Missing Deposits
categories.definition: Inquiries about cash or cheque deposits not appearing in the account balance.
